title: Ontology-Guided Knowledge Graph Construction and Robust Evidence Retrieval for Indian Knowledge Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.14050v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieving evidence from Indian Knowledge Systems is complicated by transliteration variants, ambiguous names, and relations distributed across passages. We present an ontology-guided knowledge graph (KG) pipeline that links typed entities and relations extracted with Qwen3-32B to original textual evidence. Retrieval combines sense-aware grounding, bounded graph traversal, lexical anchors, relationship-vector search, and passage reranking. We evaluate KG alone, single-vector retrieval (SV), and KG unions with SV and Entity Notes on 320 questions from Dhara Bench, matching the per-question candidate count across internal systems under BGE and Qwen rerankers. Standalone KG has the highest Precision@5 under both rerankers and the highest MRR@20 in Counting, Composite, and Multi-hop among the evaluated internal configurations. With Qwen, KG achieves Multi-hop MRR@20 of 0.8722, compared with 0.7622 for the fully reranked KG + SV union. The KG

translated_title: 面向印度知识体系的本体引导知识图谱构建与鲁棒证据检索
translated_abstract: 从印度知识体系中检索证据面临音译变体、名称歧义以及关系分散于多个段落等问题的挑战。我们提出了一个本体引导的知识图谱（KG）流水线，该流水线将使用 Qwen3-32B 抽取的类型化实体和关系与原始文本证据相链接。检索方法结合了语义感知的语义接地、有界图遍历、词法锚点、关系向量搜索以及段落重排序。我们在来自 Dhara Bench 的 320 个问题上评估了单独的 KG、单向量检索（SV），以及 KG 与 SV 和实体笔记的并集，并在 BGE 和 Qwen 两种重排序器下保持各内部系统每题候选数量一致。在所评估的内部配置中，单独的 KG 在两种重排序器下均取得最高的 Precision@5，并在计数类、复合类和多跳类问题上取得最高的 MRR@20。在使用 Qwen 重排序器时，KG 在多跳问题上达到 0.8722 的 MRR@20，而经过完整重排序的 KG + SV 并集为 0.7622。
tldr: 本文提出了一种面向印度知识体系的本体引导知识图谱构建与检索流水线，将大模型抽取的类型化实体和关系链接到原始文本证据，并通过语义接地、有界图遍历、词法锚点、关系向量搜索与段落重排序的组合检索，在 Dhara Bench 上取得优于单向量检索的证据检索效果，多跳问题 MRR@20 达到 0.8722。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an ontology-guided knowledge graph pipeline for Indian Knowledge Systems that links LLM-extracted typed entities and relations to source text, and combines sense-aware grounding, bounded graph traversal, lexical anchors, relationship-vector search, and passage reranking, achieving superior evidence retrieval over single-vector retrieval on Dhara Bench with a Multi-hop MRR@20 of 0.8722.
